_comment: Admin-console settings read through the Cloud Identity Policy API. Each entry: the setting type, the field inside its value, the comparison and the expected value. The API's setting and field names are best-effort and may differ by Workspace edition or API version: an unrecognised setting or field is reported as MANUAL with the raw value, never as a pass. Edit this file to adjust the baseline.

specs.title: Automatic forwarding to external addresses is disabled
specs.fix: Admin console > Apps > Google Workspace > Gmail > End User Access: untick 'Allow users to automatically forward incoming email to another address'.

specs.title: POP access is disabled
specs.fix: Gmail > End User Access: untick 'Enable POP access for all users'.

specs.title: IMAP access is disabled
specs.fix: Gmail > End User Access: untick 'Enable IMAP access for all users' (use modern auth clients).

specs.title: External sharing in Drive is not unrestricted
specs.fix: Admin console > Apps > Google Workspace > Drive and Docs > Sharing settings: set sharing outside the organisation to Off or Allowlisted domains.

specs.title: Users are warned when sharing outside the domain
specs.fix: Drive sharing settings: turn on 'Warn when files owned by users are shared outside the domain'.

specs.title: Publishing files on the web is disabled
specs.fix: Drive sharing settings: untick 'When sharing outside of the organization is allowed, users in the organization can publish files on the web'.

specs.title: Minimum password length is at least 14
specs.fix: Admin console > Security > Authentication > Password management: set minimum length to 14 or more.

specs.title: Password requirements are enforced at next sign-in
specs.fix: Password management: tick 'Enforce password policy at next sign-in'.

specs.title: Web session length is 12 hours or less
specs.fix: Admin console > Security > Access and data control > Google session control: set the session length to 12 hours or less.
